newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen weak on technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen weak on technical correction.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to open weak on Thursday on a technical correction following a sharp rise in the index over recent weeks, dealers said.

"People are in an overbought position and we can expect a major correction from these levels," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "Barring Hub Power, the carry forward rates of most active stocks are high and a correction is now due."
On Wednesday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 1.16 points, or 0.06 percent, to end at 2,026.83. Losers beat gainers 149 to 109.
Turnover rose to 114.61 million shares from 98.55 million in the previous session.
